title: 第11章 新的一天第12章 选择剑术和炼体术
content_zh:
第11章新的一天
刘长旭是一个非常自律的人。在这方面，父亲刘世昊对他的影响很大。
父亲刘世昊在知道刘长旭是三灵根资质之后，就对刘长旭有很高的期望，希望儿子能够在修仙之路上走的更远。
因此，刘长旭自8岁开始修炼以来，刘世昊就为儿子制定了严密的修炼计划，亲自对刘长旭的修炼进行辅导，甚至耽误了自己的修炼时间。
父亲刘世昊说的最多的就是，修炼是一辈子的事，要一刻不能放松。安排好自己的修炼时间，长期坚持下去，就会有好的结果。
良好的修炼习惯，比什么都重要。这一点也刘长旭非常认同，也一直坚定的按照父亲教导去做。
在父子俩长年不懈的努力下，刘长旭在家族同龄人中的修炼速度是最快的。
很多修仙者虽然有着不错的灵根资质，但是，由于不能够严格要求自己，在修炼上三天打鱼两天晒网，贪图一时享乐，忍受不了长期枯燥的修炼生活，白白浪费了自己良好的天赋。最终，修为进展缓慢前，等到老了以后徒呼奈何。
反而是那些本来资质不佳的修仙者，往往在自己坚持不懈的努力下，能够成就金丹元婴大道。
所以说，要想在修仙路上走的更远，除了需要良好的资质，更需要的是大毅力、大恒心、大勇气、大智慧。
在明确了自己的修仙道路后，刘长旭就立即行动起来。
先为自己每天的时间做了安排。早晨和晚上修炼功法，上午修炼法术和剑术，下午制作符箓，管理灵田、灵果树。
刘长旭在早晨和晚上修炼功法，是由于这两个时间段，不易受到打扰。修炼功法最忌讳别人打扰，特别是在行功的关键时刻，如果受到打扰，会造成突破失败，甚至走火入魔。
刘长旭虽然不满意培元炼气决这一功法。但是，这个功法能够修炼到筑基初期，而且这一功法修炼出来的法力较为精纯，对修士突破筑基非常有好处。
刘长旭在术法方面，只会火球术、灵眼术、灵耳术、轻身术。
在这次猎妖行动中，刘长旭深感斗法手段的欠缺。虽然，在猎妖行动中，刘长旭取得了丰厚战果，但是，那是有很大运气成分在里面。
所以，刘长旭决定根据自身需要，多学几种法术。
攻击法术方面，刘长旭准备学习水箭术，这是一种群攻法术，虽然，威力不如火球术，但是，对付大范围目标效果很好。
防御法术方面，土墙术、金甲术防御效果最好。可惜，刘长旭没有金灵根和土灵根。只能选择木盾术。
另外，刘长旭还准备学缠绕术，这种术法有很好的困敌效果。

剑术方面，刘长旭手上没有什么好的剑术。刘长旭准备在中午吃饭时问问父亲。
还有就是，虽然自己手上有符笔，但是，制作符箓用的符墨、符纸，还需要去族库兑换。
刘长旭先来到自己的练功房练习法术。这个练功房是由青岗石所建，青岗石是一种一阶下品灵材，石质坚硬，只是不能用来炼器。且产地分布广泛、价格极为低廉，主要用于殿堂、城墙的修建。
家族就有好几处青岗石矿。刘长旭的这座练功房所需的石材，总共费55个家族贡献点，相当于55块低阶灵石。
刘长旭的这座练功房，高八尺，长八丈，宽二丈。练功房内设施较为简单，只有一个蒲团，练习法术用的靶石一块，这块靶石也是用青岗石制成。
刘长旭首先练习的是火球术，目前他的火球术只是达到了小成，在这次猎妖行动中，由于施法速度不快，对付身形灵活的妖兽非常吃力。
只见刘长旭不断掐动法诀，一朵朵拳头大的火球，极速向着靶石而去。一时间，靶石上火星四溅，很快这块一尺厚的靶石就已经坑坑洼洼的。
在练习一段时间，法力枯竭后，就开始打坐恢复法力。
恢复法力后，又开始练习水箭术。刘长旭按照术法中记载的行功路线掐诀施法后，一股水汽在空中浮现，只是还没等凝聚水箭，就因为自己行功路线不对而消失。
刘长旭也不气馁，不断总结经验调整行功路线，终于，开始凝聚出水箭的模样，将水箭打出后，也只在靶石上留下一道水痕。
虽然目前没有什么威力，但只要坚持不断的练习，威力就会逐步提升。
木盾术，则是需要施法将木属性灵气凝聚置于身前。木盾术防护的效果，取决于木属性灵气凝聚的密度。
刘长旭练习了半个时辰，只是练习出了一团青色虚影。想要炼成能用的木盾术，还需较长时间。
缠绕术也是木属性法术，需要施法者施法将木属性灵气凝聚成藤蔓状或绳状，用来束缚敌人。也是一个很实用的法术。
缠绕术和木盾术由于均是木属性法术是想通的，有了木盾术的基础，很快能凝聚出绳状青色虚影。以后，勤加练习即可。
（本章完）
content_en:
Chapter 11 A new day
Liu Changxu is a very self-disciplined person. In this regard, his father Liu Shihao had a great influence on him.
After his father Liu Shihao knew that Liu Changxu had the qualification of the Three Spiritual Roots, he had high expectations for Liu Changxu and hoped that his son could go further on the road to immortality.
Therefore, since Liu Changxu began to practice at the age of 8, Liu Shihao has formulated a strict practice plan for his son and personally tutored Liu Changxu in his practice, even delaying his own practice time.
What his father Liu Shihao said the most was that cultivation is a lifelong matter and one cannot relax for a moment. Arrange your own practice time and stick to it for a long time, and you will have good results.
Good practice habits are more important than anything else. Liu Changxu agrees with this very much and has always followed his father's instructions firmly.
Thanks to the unremitting efforts of father and son over the years, Liu Changxu's cultivation speed is the fastest among his peers in the family.
Although many immortal cultivators have good spiritual qualifications, they are unable to strictly demand themselves. They spend three days fishing and two days drying nets in cultivation, coveting temporary pleasure and unable to endure the long-term boring cultivation life, thus wasting their good talents. In the end, before the progress of cultivation is slow, it will be useless to do nothing when I grow old.
On the contrary, those cultivators with poor qualifications are often able to achieve the Golden Elixir Yuanying Dao through their unremitting efforts.
Therefore, if you want to go further on the road to immortality, in addition to good qualifications, you also need great perseverance, great perseverance, great courage, and great wisdom.
After clarifying his path of cultivating immortality, Liu Changxu immediately took action.
First make arrangements for your daily time. Practice exercises in the morning and evening, practice spells and swordsmanship in the morning, make talismans and manage spiritual fields and spiritual fruit trees in the afternoon.
Liu Changxu practices the exercises in the morning and evening because he is less likely to be disturbed during these two time periods. It is most taboo to be disturbed by others when practicing the exercises, especially at the critical moment of the exercise. If you are disturbed, it will cause the breakthrough to fail, or even go crazy.
Although Liu Changxu was not satisfied with the Peiyuan Qi Refining Technique. However, this technique can be practiced to the early stage of foundation building, and the mana produced by this technique is relatively pure, which is very beneficial for monks to break through foundation building.
In terms of magic, Liu Changxu only knows fireball, spiritual eye, spiritual ear, and light body techniques.
During this monster hunting operation, Liu Changxu deeply felt the lack of fighting methods. Although Liu Changxu achieved great results during the demon hunting operation, there was a lot of luck involved.
Therefore, Liu Changxu decided to learn several more spells according to his own needs.
In terms of attack spells, Liu Changxu plans to learn water archery, which is a group attack spell. Although it is not as powerful as fireball, it is very effective against large-scale targets.
In terms of defensive spells, Earth Wall Spell and Golden Armor Spell have the best defensive effect. It's a pity that Liu Changxu doesn't have golden spiritual roots or earth spiritual roots. You can only choose the wooden shield technique.
In addition, Liu Changxu is also planning to learn the entanglement technique, which has a very good effect on trapping enemies.
In terms of swordsmanship, Liu Changxu didn't have any good swordsmanship. Liu Changxu planned to ask his father during lunch.
Also, although I have a talisman pen in my hand, the talisman ink and talisman paper used to make the talismans still need to be exchanged at the family treasury.
Liu Changxu first came to his practice room to practice spells. This practice room is built of green granite, which is a first-level low-grade spiritual material. The stone is hard, but it cannot be used to refine weapons. Its origin is widely distributed and its price is extremely low. It is mainly used in the construction of palaces and city walls.
The family owns several greenstone mines. The stones required for Liu Changxu's practice room cost a total of 55 family contribution points, which is equivalent to 55 low-level spiritual stones.
Liu Changxu's practice room is eight feet high, eight feet long and two feet wide. The facilities in the practice room are relatively simple, with only a futon and a target stone for practicing spells.One piece, this target stone is also made of green granite.
Liu Changxu first practiced the fireball technique. At present, his fireball technique has only reached a small level. In this monster hunting operation, due to the slow casting speed, it was very difficult to deal with the flexible monsters.
I saw Liu Changxu continuously twisting the magic formula, and fireballs as big as fists flew towards the target rock at high speed. For a moment, sparks flew all over the target rock, and soon the one-foot-thick target rock was full of pits.
After practicing for a period of time and your mana is exhausted, you can start meditating to restore your mana.
After recovering his mana, he started practicing water archery again. After Liu Changxu cast the spell according to the exercise route recorded in the spell, a stream of water vapor appeared in the air, but before the water arrow could be condensed, it disappeared because his exercise route was wrong.
Liu Changxu was not discouraged and kept summarizing his experience and adjusting his exercise route. Finally, he began to condense the appearance of a water arrow. After shooting the water arrow, it only left a water mark on the target rock.
Although it doesn't have much power at the moment, as long as you keep practicing, the power will gradually increase.
The Wood Shield Technique requires casting a spell to condense the wood attribute aura in front of the body. The protective effect of the wooden shield depends on the density of the wood attribute aura.
Liu Changxu practiced for half an hour, but he only produced a group of cyan shadows. It will take a long time to refine a usable wooden shield technique.
Entanglement is also a wood-attribute spell. It requires the caster to cast a spell to condense the wood-attribute aura into a vine-like or rope-like shape to bind the enemy. It is also a very practical spell.
The entanglement technique and the wooden shield technique are both wood-attribute spells. With the foundation of the wooden shield technique, a rope-like cyan shadow can be quickly condensed. From now on, just practice more frequently.
(End of chapter)
